clips.title: The story
paras: At Silverpine's coast, the shaman completes the Call of Water at the Brazier of Everfount. The rite clears nearby corruption, and a spirit of pure water appears.
At the Brazier of Everfount, your final words call forth a burst of light. It scatters the minor spirits that threaten the spring, and the shore falls quiet.

A Minor Manifestation of Water appears beside the brazier after the spirits are gone. The spirit thanks you for the rite and says the taint here has ebbed. Yet life across Silverpine's decaying lands continues to wane, and the Horde's shamans must stay watchful to preserve it.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Light explodes as you finish the incantation. The sounds of the water drops hitting the flame have died down and your senses are overcome as the corrupt spirits around you are destroyed.
